pipeline: PyTorch -> Torch-MLIR -> Linalg -> SCF/flat-SCF -> LLM2FPGA passes -> Calyx -> native SystemVerilog

simulation.invocation_protocol: go held high until generated done

coverage: All 83 generated SV memory ports are connected through the compiler memory ABI.
50 buffers and one token input are initialized from the exported PyTorch program.
Compiler global constants are initialized from flat-SCF bindings.
Output port 51 is exposed as result0/result1.
limitations: This is simulation of the BRAM/LUTRAM wrapper, not a bitstream or board run.
The wrapper exposes a fixed RC result, not yet PCIe or DDR3 transport.
